name: Mueang southwest retail and Makham Tia
capture_notes: Target-side retail and local-market cluster around Phokhun Thale, Tesco Lotus HomePro, Central Suratthani, and the new bus terminal; direct PTT competition keeps net opportunity below gross demand.

name: Mueang civic and transport core
capture_notes: City-center hospitals, malls, markets, bus connections, and multiple public chargers; strong demand but dense competition.

name: Phunphin airport and intercity gateway
capture_notes: Airport, rail, Route 417, and long-distance traffic support a separate corridor node; do not diffuse this pool across Mueang local roads.

name: Route 401 east connector
capture_notes: Regional connector toward Kanchanadit and Don Sak with roadside demand; keep heat aligned to the corridor.

name: Route 44 south gateway
capture_notes: Long-distance east-west travel corridor with lower urban capture than Mueang retail zones.
